problem_statement: A parent silently discards a Child Update Request containing a malformed CSL Timeout TLV from a CSL-synchronized child. With warning-level MLE diagnostics enabled, malformed timeout values must produce a parse-error diagnostic, consistent with other malformed TLVs. Valid and absent CSL Timeout TLVs must continue to be accepted, and a valid value must update the child timeout. Preserve existing dataset validation and successful-save behavior.
build_command: cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DOT_PLATFORM=external -DOT_BUILD_GTEST=ON -DOT_APP_CLI=OFF -DOT_APP_NCP=OFF -DOT_APP_RCP=OFF -DOT_MTD=OFF -DOT_RCP=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DOT_LOG_LEVEL=WARN -DOT_LOG_OUTPUT=PLATFORM_DEFINED && cmake --build build --target ot-ftd-gtest -j$(nproc)
orientation: GoogleTests use the real FTD core and upstream FakePlatform. Run `run_tests` to configure, rebuild, and execute MLE diagnostics and upstream dataset controls. Warning logging and CSL transmission are enabled; no radio hardware is needed. Tests under tests/ are protected.
